## Definition of Ready

<!-- The problem, the requirement IDs or issue it serves, the acceptance criteria, and what is out
of scope. For a fix: the symptom and how it was reproduced. -->

## Changes

<!-- What changed and why, at the level of behavior and design; the alternatives considered. -->

## Verification

<!-- The verify command and its result; the regression test and its red output before the fix;
anything not verified and why. -->

## Requirements and docs

<!-- Requirement IDs added, changed or retired; ADRs; docs and CLAUDE.md updated, or "none
needed" with why. -->

## Instrumentation

<!-- Logs, metrics or traces added or removed on the touched paths, or why they are adequate;
performance before/after, or "not touched". -->

## Privacy review

<!-- "Read the staged diff of every commit; nothing private about the maintainer, their family
or their computers" — or what was removed. -->
